occurrence_sentence: Kipu Quantum GmbH, a German quantum software company focusing on developing application-dependent and hardware-specific quantum algorithms that are commercialized as enterprise solutions, joins DLR's project "BASIQ: Battery materials simulation using quantum computers", which is part of the DLR Quantum Computing Initiative (DLR QCI).
